purpose: Teach: 目黒/野中/渡部/三宅/酒井/武部/高野/久保田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、目黒オフィスの移転計画を進めろ
lines.en: Get the Meguro office relocation plan moving forward.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Measured tempo. Slight pause after each clause. The tone of someone used to being obeyed without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の野中課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate Sales Manager Nonaka's travel schedule.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice. Quick intake before the action items—showing readiness without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、取締役の渡部様の交代を準備しろ
lines.en: Prepare the transition for our Director Watabe.
lines.style: Formal, deliberate. Measured weight on each word. The careful tone of someone discussing personnel changes—administrative but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の三宅様の新企画を採用します
lines.en: Yes. I'll implement PR Manager Miyake's new proposal.
lines.style: Confirming with a half-beat of emphasis. Slightly faster than before—showing initiative. Clean handoff, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、財務の酒井様に予算策定を依頼しろ
lines.en: Request that Finance Manager Sakai handle the budget planning.
lines.style: Steady, delegating. Slight rise on the name—making clear who this concerns. The tone of someone distributing responsibility with confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新任の武部部長を歓迎します
lines.en: Yes. I'll give a warm welcome to the new Department Head Takebe.
lines.style: Warmer than previous lines, but still professional. Gentle shift—showing that recognition matters here too. Light, welcoming on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の高野様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Put HR Manager Takano in charge of the new employee training program.
lines.style: Clear and final. Slight emphasis on 'in charge'—making the delegation explicit. Composed, giving the instruction with full authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。技術の久保田主任にプロジェクトを任せます
lines.en: Yes. I'll assign the project to Senior Technician Kubota.
lines.style: Crisp closure. Quick, decisive. The 'yes' lands cleanly—showing understanding and readiness to execute. Slight finality on the end.
